summary: Collection crib sold in the ten named finishes, like Newport or Addison.
notes: each finish is its own variant: media.json keys are "Natural||Natural", "Almond||Almond", ...

bundle starts with the mattress only. A collection's own toddler bed, bed rail kit and guard rails are separate products: make them with --template conversion-kit, then add their slugs to "bundle" (see Newport Crib for bundlePriceOverrides, bundleOptional and bundleUnchecked)
set "collection" and fill "related" with the matching dressers and nightstands
for a crib in a collection that already exists, --like "<that collection's crib>" copies all of this
